verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an interactive API reference or API explorer with runnable, in-browser examples for QuickBooks Online. The PHP SDK README's 'Create, Update, Read, and Delete Examples' are static code samples. The sandbox environment is a testing building block, not an interactive reference. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, so no machine-readable reference was found either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
